confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bogota price levels; no live listings, booking pages or web sources were used for the anchors. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the better-founded; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season and are less certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor. FX is the RBA observation for 14 October 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Latin American capital-city basis (Medellin, Lima, Mexico City) for restaurant and hotel levels, adjusted to Bogota's central districts. No single comparable city was used as a direct source.
